title: Identification of prochlorperazine dimaleate as a Sortase A inhibitor from FDA libraries for MRSA infection treatment
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21666-21677
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01781E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abhinit Kumar, Sonali Chhabra, Raman Parkesh
Prochlorperazine inhibits SrtA enzyme and shows strong anti-MRSA, anti-biofilm activity, with low mammalian toxicity, and significant in vivo efficacy, thus, highlighting its promise as a novel scaffold for combating resistant S. aureus infection.
